paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s boys beat Grissom of Huntsville, Alabama, 57–49 on Friday at Corinth High School for their fifth straight win. BallerTV, the Lighthouse Classic’s broadcast partner, posted the final on its game replay. The Warriors finished Thanksgiving week with three wins in five days and improved to 6–1.

Two of those wins came against Alabama schools. Pontotoc beat Florence 68–53 on Monday, then put up 73 points in a 32-point win over Baldwyn on Tuesday. Grissom held the Warriors to their lowest point total of the week, but Pontotoc held the Tigers under 50 to complete the sweep.

Defense has held up throughout the streak. Louisville scored 34, Tupelo 54, Florence 53, Baldwyn 41 and Grissom 49. That comes to 46.2 points allowed per game. The only closer finish in that stretch came at Tupelo on Nov. 19, when the Warriors won 59–54.

Houston brings a different scoring test to Pontotoc on Tuesday, Dec. 1. The Hilltoppers averaged 75.3 points in their first six games, reaching 80 four times. The boys’ game is set for 7:15 p.m. at Pontotoc.
